fields.summary: TC-755-01: Phase 1 COA Lambdas Execute Successfully After Node 22.x Upgrade

content.text: Linked Story: CREWCMBR-755
Precondition: All Phase 1 COA Processor Repo Lambdas have been upgraded to Node 22.x runtime. A valid aggregated COA event is available to trigger end-to-end Phase 1 processing.
TEST STEPS
Step
Action
Test Data
Expected Result
Verify the runtime configuration of all Phase 1 COA Lambdas in AWS console or via CLI
AWS Lambda console / CLI for crew-qa2-techp Phase 1 COA Lambdas
All Phase 1 COA Lambdas show Node.js 22.x as the configured runtime
Trigger a CSS pairing and assignment event to initiate the Phase 1 COA processing pipeline
Valid CSS pairing and assignment event published to Kafka topics
Kafka events are published and the stream app aggregates them successfully
Verify the ESM Lambda (Node 22.x) listens to the aggregated topic and invokes the COA Step Function
ESM Lambda CloudWatch Logs after aggregated event processing
ESM Lambda executes without Node.js runtime errors and successfully invokes the COA Step Function
Verify all Phase 1 Step Function Lambda states complete without Node.js runtime errors
Step Function execution history and CloudWatch Logs for all Lambda states
All Lambda states succeed with Node 22.x runtime - no deprecated API errors, no incompatibility errors
Verify the COA record is correctly written to DynamoDB after full Phase 1 processing on Node 22.x
crew-qa2-techp-cmn-coatable DynamoDB record after processing
COA record is written correctly to DynamoDB - all fields populated as expected with no data loss from the Node 22.x upgrade
